title: Formation dynamics of inorganic iodine species during UV-based advanced oxidation of iopamidol and iohexol and their correlation with iodinated disinfection by-product yields
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,2152-2160
DOI: 10.1039/D5EW00393H, Paper
Hojoong Ji, Jaehyeong Park, Seonyoung An, Seo-Yeong Choi, Jong Kwon Choe
This study compared iodine species formation during treatment of iohexol and iopamidol across different UV-AOPs. UV with NaOCl and PMS fully oxidized iodide to iodate minimizing iodinated disinfection by-products while others did not.
